House & c6 Acres of Land at Cribbons Lane, Kildare, Rathangan, Co. Kildare

BrochureContent.Content:
Kelly Hudson Properties proudly present this beautiful 4 bedroom detached dormer bungalow (c.242.38sqmt) on c.6 acres together with yard, workshop, stable block and cattle shed to the market for sale. 

This property offers an abundance of bright airy and spacious living accommodation and comes to the market in good clean and tidy condition having been well maintained by its current owners. The property comprises of a porchway leading to entrance hallway, kitchen, utility room, dining room, living room, sitting room, family bathroom and 4 large bedrooms, two of which are ensuite. There are two bedrooms on the ground floor with a further two upstairs. Outside is a large detached garage which parking for a number of vehicles or additional storage space.  

Outside and adjacent to the family home, the property benefits a large concrete yard that has its own private gated entrance, a workshop, stable block consisting of 5 stables and a cattle shed. 

Situated c.1.9km Rathangan village which is home to a host of excellent amenities including shops, bars, restaurants, community playground, garage, church and both primary & secondary schools. The larger towns of Kildare and Newbridge are both also a short drive away. 

Viewing is highly recommended strictly by prior appointment only.
